plugin-settings.title: Auth Guard Settings
plugin-settings.captcha-provider-desc: Select the bot protection service to use for login and registration forms.
plugin-settings.captcha-site-key-desc: The public site key from your captcha provider dashboard.
plugin-settings.captcha-secret-key-desc: The secret key from your captcha provider dashboard. For reCAPTCHA Enterprise, use your Google Cloud API key.
plugin-settings.recaptcha-legacy-desc: Use the standard reCAPTCHA API with a legacy secret key instead of reCAPTCHA Enterprise.
plugin-settings.captcha-project-id-desc: Your Google Cloud project ID (required for reCAPTCHA Enterprise).
plugin-settings.captcha-on-login-desc: Require captcha verification on the login form.
plugin-settings.captcha-on-register-desc: Require captcha verification on the registration form.
plugin-settings.captcha-on-reset-password-desc: Require captcha verification on the forgot-password and password reset form.
plugin-settings.captcha-on-verify-email-desc: Require captcha on the account activation page (email confirmation / code).
plugin-settings.captcha-on-verify-new-email-desc: Require captcha when the user confirms a new email address.
plugin-settings.captcha-on-renew-password-desc: Require captcha on the set-password or renew-password form (e.g. after a reset or change link).
plugin-settings.two-factor-enabled-desc: Allow users to set up TOTP-based two-factor authentication for their accounts.
plugin-settings.two-factor-issuer-desc: The name shown in authenticator apps (e.g., Google Authenticator). Defaults to your site name.
plugin-settings.magic-login-enabled-desc: Allow users to sign in via a one-time link sent to their email address.
plugin-settings.magic-login-expire-desc: How long the magic login link stays valid.

errors.captcha-verification-failed: Please verify that you are not a robot.
errors.two-factor-required: Two-factor authentication is required. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
errors.two-factor-too-many-attempts: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

two-factor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
two-factor.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account using an authenticator app.
two-factor.scan-qr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app:
two-factor.verify-code: Enter the 6-digit code from your app to verify:
two-factor.disable-desc: Enter your current 2FA code and password to disable.
two-factor.login-desc: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
two-factor.login-invalid-code: Invalid authentication code. Please try again.

magic-login.sent-desc: We've sent a login link to your email address. Click the link to sign in.
magic-login.expired: This login link has expired. Please request a new one.
magic-login.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
magic-login.no-panel-access: This account has no access to the management panel.

panel-2fa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
panel-2fa.global-off: Global 2FA is disabled; player-level overrides are unavailable.
panel-2fa.global-off-sidebar: 2FA is disabled in Auth Guard settings.
panel-2fa.remove-confirm: Remove two-factor authentication for this player? They can set it up again from their account or you can set it from this panel again.

MANAGE_AUTH_GUARD_SETTINGS.title: Manage Auth Guard Settings
MANAGE_AUTH_GUARD_SETTINGS.description: Can configure captcha providers, two-factor authentication, and magic login settings.

MANAGE_PLAYER_TWO_FACTOR.title: Manage players' 2FA
MANAGE_PLAYER_TWO_FACTOR.description: View and change two-factor authentication for players from the player detail page and the edit player modal.

activity-logs.UPDATED_AUTH_GUARD_SETTINGS: {username} updated the Auth Guard plugin settings.

magic-login.heading: Signing you in
magic-login.lead: We are checking your sign-in link.
